candidates.name: rs-fsrs 1.2.1
candidates.fit_for_gap: G2-fsrs: replace the stub scheduler in substrate/learner-model/src/fsrs.rs that never reads difficulty

evidence.claim: Scheduler-only Rust FSRS from the same organisation as fsrs-rs; 50 stars, updated 2026-09-01
cargo search reports rs-fsrs 1.2.1, 'Rust-based Scheduler for FSRS'
Sibling crate exposes next_states(Option<MemoryState>, desired_retention, days_elapsed) returning stability, difficulty, interval per rating; the same model maps onto FSRSCard

risks: Dependency weight not confirmed by cargo tree; verdict is inferred from crate descriptions
API parity with fsrs-rs assumed from shared organisation; confirm at spec
candidates.decision_rationale: Scheduler-only fits the learner-model binary and the pack's build-speed policy; fsrs-rs ships an optimizer with a machine-learning backend the binary does not need.

candidates.name: fsrs-rs 6.6.2

risks: Optimizer pulls a machine-learning backend; too heavy for the learner-model binary this phase

candidates.name: Feynman CLI research workflow (prompts/deepresearch.md, .feynman/agents/*.md, SYSTEM.md)

evidence.claim: Seven-stage prompt with required artifacts, scale gate, file-based subagent handoff, verifier-before-reviewer, post-edit grep proof, and a provenance sidecar template
Writer agent frontmatter tools allowlist contains no web or fetch tools; verifier gets web_search and fetch_content back
Label vocabulary verified/unverified/blocked/inferred; slug rule of at most five words with generic names banned
combineSignals drops unavailable signals from the weight denominator and stores appliedWeights; SCORE_SENSITIVITY_PROFILES classify rank stability (survey, not re-read)
Claim id is sha256(scope:normalised text) truncated to 16 hex; status escalates on merge (survey, not re-read)

risks: Prompts are written for Pi tool names; every tool reference must be re-mapped to the pack's harness tools
The rank code is TypeScript; porting to python3 must be verified against a fixture, not assumed
candidates.decision_rationale: MIT-licensed, prose-level mechanisms that map onto the pack's existing stage skills without a runtime dependency.

candidates.name: Headless harness execution (claude -p, codex exec)
candidates.fit_for_gap: G1-daemon-job: implement --daemon-job by spawning a headless harness running the deep-research driver

evidence.claim: A claude -p --input-format stream-json process was executing the control-plane-to-companion phase during this analyze
codex exec --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust is documented as a vetted headless automation path with verified hook firing

risks: A headless child inherits operator hooks; the spec must scope which hooks a research child may fire
Harness binary presence is an environment fact; absence must produce a blocked job, not a crash
candidates.decision_rationale: Reuses stage skills verbatim and gives the daemon background execution without reimplementing integrations in Rust.
